summary: Paulsdale is a historic site in Mount Laurel Township, New Jersey. It was the birthplace and childhood home of Alice Paul, a major leader of the women's suffrage movement in the United States. The property was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1991.
one_line: Paulsdale, in Mount Laurel Township, New Jersey, is the birthplace and childhood home of suffragist Alice Paul and a 1991 National Historic Landmark.
